svg.title: Industrial electrician — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as industrial electrician, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A switchgear panel has three separated supply terminals, a disconnect lever and a breaker module. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
